decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
response.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results support the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rejected.why: Lymphomatous Meningitis is a possible diagnosis, but it is less specific than Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.
Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy is unlikely due to the absence of EBV/EBER.
Glioblastoma is unlikely due to the brain biopsy results.
Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy is unlikely due to the brain biopsy results and the absence of EBV/EBER.
Multiple Sclerosis is unlikely due to the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results.
